Expeditions
===========

Contents
--------

Overview
----------

[![Expeditions Loading Screen.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/1/1a/Expeditions_Loading_Screen.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Expeditions_Loading_Screen.png)

Expeditions is a game mode primarily used for farming and progression. It comes right after [Adventures](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Adventures "Adventures")
 in difficulty, and features a different special enemy in every Chaos difficulty.

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

Chaos Tiers
-------------

[![Vanguard Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/c/ce/Vanguard_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Vanguard_Icon.png)

[![Gorbstock lane icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/d/da/Gorbstock_lane_icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Gorbstock_lane_icon.png)

### Chaos I

*   Introduced Enemies: [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Shield Goblin Gorbstock](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Goblin_Gorbstock "Shield Goblin Gorbstock")
    
*   Unlocked after finishing the [Campaign](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Campaign "Campaign")
    

[Vanguards](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
 are shield goblins who block all projectile attacks from their front side. Projectiles attacks will be ineffective, so avoid projectiles unless you have a piercer servo/chip or you are able to attack them from behind with projectiles.

  

[![Cybork Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/a/a4/Cybork_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Cybork_Icon.png)

[![Thorc lane icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/f/f1/Thorc_lane_icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Thorc_lane_icon.png)

### Chaos II

*   Introduced Enemies: [Cybork](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Cybork "Cybork")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Cybork](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Cybork "Cybork")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Thorc the Terrible](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Thorc_the_Terrible "Thorc the Terrible")
    
*   Unlocked after reaching 580 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

[Cybork](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Cybork "Cybork")
 are orcs who send out a projectile with each attack that will disable any [Auras](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Auras "Defenses")
, [Traps](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Traps "Defenses")
, and [Nodes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Nodes "Defenses")
. Stick to using [Towers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Towers "Defenses")
 and [Blockades](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Blockades "Defenses")
 unless your [Auras](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Auras "Defenses")
, [Traps](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Traps "Defenses")
, and [Nodes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Nodes "Defenses")
 are equipped with a 100% Tenacity Servo or the Automation Shard (either of these will prevent your defenses from being disabled). A common strategy high level players who still wish to use [Auras](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Auras "Defenses")
, [Traps](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Traps "Defenses")
, and [Nodes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Nodes "Defenses")
 use is to equip a 100% Tenacity Servo or Automation on their [Reflect Beam](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Reflect_Beam "Reflect Beam")
. Because the [Cybork](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Cybork "Cybork")
's attack sends out a projectile, the [Reflect Beam](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Reflect_Beam "Reflect Beam")
 is capable of reflecting these projectiles back, keeping your [Auras](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Auras "Defenses")
, [Traps](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Traps "Defenses")
, and [Nodes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Nodes "Defenses")
 safe.

  

[![Geode Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/3/33/Geode_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Geode_Icon.png)

[![Geode Prime lane icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/9/9d/Geode_Prime_lane_icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Geode_Prime_lane_icon.png)

### Chaos III

*   Introduced Enemies: [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
    , [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Geode Prime - Leader of the Shield Geodes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Geode_Prime_-_Leader_of_the_Shield_Geodes "Geode Prime - Leader of the Shield Geodes")
    
*   Unlocked after reaching 1,050 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

[Shield Geodes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
 produce a spherical projectile shield which will reflect all projectile attacks. Projectile attacks will largely be ineffective unless you can get inside the shield and damage the [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
's core. Using projectile based defenses is highly discouraged unless they are equipped with piercer servo.

  

[![Berserker Orc Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/2a/Berserker_Orc_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Berserker_Orc_Icon.png)

[![Gnash.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/7/7f/Gnash.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Gnash.png)

### Chaos IV

*   Introduced Enemies: [Berserker Orc](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Berserker Orc](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
    , [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
    , [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Gnash the Flame Lance](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Gnash_the_Flame_Lance&action=edit&redlink=1 "Gnash the Flame Lance (page does not exist)")
    
*   Unlocked after reaching 1,740 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

[Berserker Orcs](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
 are tanky, fast moving, and hard hitting lady orcs with immunity to all slowing effects. They should be prioritized and eliminated quickly, as they can make quick work of your [Blockades](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Blockades "Defenses")
 and/or slip through to your Crystal Core if left unchecked.

  

[![Dark Assassin Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b3/Dark_Assassin_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Dark_Assassin_Icon.png)

[![Skarnash Miniboss Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/7/76/Skarnash_Miniboss_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Skarnash_Miniboss_Icon.png)

### Chaos V

*   Introduced Enemies: [Dark Assassin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Dark Assassin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
    , [Cybork](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Cybork "Cybork")
    , [Berserker Orc](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
    , [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
     (1 per wave starting on wave 3), [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Skarnash The Terrible](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Skarnash_The_Terrible&action=edit&redlink=1 "Skarnash The Terrible (page does not exist)")
    
*   Unlocked after reaching 2,750 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

[Dark Assassins](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
 are flying enemies that exclusively focus on attacking the player (although they can still damage [Defenses](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses "Defenses")
 or the Crystal Core if you bring them within striking distance). After spawning, they will target a player. If you are targeted, purple smoke will appear around your hero and you will hear a hissing sound. Shortly afterwards, the [Dark Assassin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
 will teleport onto your hero, disabling your hero abilities and basic attacks. You will still be able to move around and use your pet ability. They can be countered by utilizing [Defenses](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses "Defenses")
 or pet abilities that can stun or knock up enemies, or by simply killing them with [Defenses](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses "Defenses")
 before they kill you.

  

[![Regular Hex Thrower Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/82/Regular_Hex_Thrower_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Regular_Hex_Thrower_Icon.png)

[![Hex Thrower Miniboss Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/1/1b/Hex_Thrower_Miniboss_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Hex_Thrower_Miniboss_Icon.png)

### Chaos VI

*   Introduced Enemies: [Hex Thrower](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Hex_Thrower "Hex Thrower")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Hex Thrower](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Hex_Thrower "Hex Thrower")
    , [Dark Assassin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
     (from wave 3 onwards), [Berserker Orc](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
    , [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
    , [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Sniper Warbleed](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Sniper_Warbleed&action=edit&redlink=1 "Sniper Warbleed (page does not exist)")
    
*   Unlocked after reaching 3,800 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

[Hex Throwers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Hex_Thrower "Hex Thrower")
 are elite javelin throwers who can attack your defenses from extremely far away. Their attacks leave a devastating curse on your [Defenses](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses "Defenses")
 in an area on hit. The easiest way to counter them is by using the [EV2](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=EV2&action=edit&redlink=1 "EV2 (page does not exist)")
's [Reflect Beam](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Reflect_Beam "Reflect Beam")
. If you don't have [EV2](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=EV2&action=edit&redlink=1 "EV2 (page does not exist)")
, avoid clumping [Defenses](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses "Defenses")
 around your [Blockades](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Blockades "Defenses")
.

  

[![Kobolt Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/d/d5/Kobolt_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Kobolt_Icon.png)

[![Zapper Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/7/7c/Zapper_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Zapper_Icon.png)

### Chaos VII

*   Introduced Enemies: [Kobolts](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Kobolts "Kobolts")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Kobolts](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Kobolts "Kobolts")
    , [Hex Thrower](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Hex_Thrower "Hex Thrower")
    , [Dark Assassin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
     (from wave 3 onwards), [Berserker Orc](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
    , [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
    , [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Zapper](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Zapper "Zapper")
    
*   Unlocked after reaching 5,300 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

[Kobolts](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Kobolts "Kobolts")
 are special flying kobolds that focus on dive bombing your [Towers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Towers "Defenses")
. On contact, they will explode, dealing a large amount of damage and disabling your [Towers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Towers "Defenses")
. If you do choose to use [Towers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Towers "Defenses")
, be very careful with your placement.

  

[![DeathWeaverHeadIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/3/3d/DeathWeaverHeadIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:DeathWeaverHeadIcon.png)

[![QueenDeathWeaverHeadIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/4/45/QueenDeathWeaverHeadIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:QueenDeathWeaverHeadIcon.png)

### Chaos VIII

*   Introduced Enemies: [Death Weavers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Death_Weavers "Death Weavers")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Death Weavers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Death_Weavers "Death Weavers")
    , [Hex Thrower](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Hex_Thrower "Hex Thrower")
    , [Dark Assassin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
     (from wave 3 onwards), [Berserker Orc](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
    , [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
    , [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Queen Deathweaver](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Queen_Deathweaver&action=edit&redlink=1 "Queen Deathweaver (page does not exist)")
    
*   Unlocked after reaching 7,850 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

[Death Weavers](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Death_Weaver "Death Weaver")
 are spiders which leave a spider web on the ground after they are killed. These spider webs will curse your defenses, decreasing attack speed, damage, and range. These webs cannot be countered by 100% [Tenacity Servo](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
 or [Automation](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards#Hyper_Shards "Shards")
. These spiders also hit quite hard and have a decent amount of health, and they'll also web you and slow you down if they hit you. Due to their webs, [Auras](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Auras "Defenses")
, [Traps](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Traps "Defenses")
, and [Nodes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defenses#Nodes "Defenses")
 are generally not recommended.

  

[![ElderWyvernHeadIcon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/3/3f/ElderWyvernHeadIcon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:ElderWyvernHeadIcon.png)

[![AncientWyvern.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/a/ad/AncientWyvern.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:AncientWyvern.png)

### Chaos IX

*   Introduced Enemies: [Elder Wyvern](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Elder_Wyvern "Elder Wyvern")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Elder Wyvern](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Elder_Wyvern "Elder Wyvern")
    , [Hex Thrower](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Hex_Thrower "Hex Thrower")
    , [Dark Assassin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
     (from wave 3 onwards), [Berserker Orc](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
    , [Shield Geode](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shield_Geode "Shield Geode")
    , [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    
*   Chaos Miniboss: Ancient Wyvern
*   Unlocked after reaching 9,850 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

[Elder Wyverns](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Elder_Wyvern "Elder Wyvern")
 are grounded wyverns that buff nearby enemies, providing damage resistance and immunity to any [Crowd Control](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Crowd_Control&action=edit&redlink=1 "Crowd Control (page does not exist)")
 effects. Because of this buff, you are essentially forced into high damage setups that kill the enemies with raw damage. The most commonly employed strategy for Chaos 9 is a [Fissure of Embermount](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Fissure_of_Embermount "Fissure of Embermount")
 build with the Embermount Flames mod, which allows the Fissure to continue damaging enemies even after they have moved out of range.

  

[![War Party Icons.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/c/cd/War_Party_Icons.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:War_Party_Icons.png)

### Chaos X

*   Introduced Enemies: [Orc Chieftain](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Orc_Chieftain "Orc Chieftain")
    , [Orc Queen](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Orc_Queen "Orc Queen")
    , [Berserker Goblin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Goblin "Berserker Goblin")
    
*   Chaos Enemies: [Orc Chieftain](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Orc_Chieftain "Orc Chieftain")
    , [Orc Queen](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Orc_Queen "Orc Queen")
    , [Berserker Goblin](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Goblin "Berserker Goblin")
    , [Hex Thrower](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Hex_Thrower "Hex Thrower")
    , [Berserker Orc](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
    , [Cybork](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Cybork "Cybork")
    , [Vanguard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Vanguard "Vanguard")
    , and a special group of enemies, [Frost Enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies#Special_Level_Enemies "Enemies")
    .
*   Chaos Miniboss: [Orc Warlord](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Orc_Warlord&action=edit&redlink=1 "Orc Warlord (page does not exist)")
    
*   Unlocked after reaching 12,750 [champion score](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Champion_score "Champion score")
    

Unlike the prior chaos tiers, this one excludes some common enemies such as [Witherbeasts](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies#Common_Enemies "Enemies")
, [Dark Mages](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Mage "Dark Mage")
, and [Dark Assassins](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dark_Assassin "Dark Assassin")
.  

[Orc Chieftains](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Orc_Chieftain "Orc Chieftain")
 are bulky leaders of the Goblins and Orcs. When their health is low, they unleash a rallying Warcry, granting themselves increased speed, healing over time, and near-immunity to damage and status ailments for several seconds. Nearby Orcs and Goblins have their speed and damage reduction increased, along with healing over time.  

[Orc Queens](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Orc_Queen "Orc Queen")
 are relentless fighters who cannot be slowed or stunned, and they have higher health than [Berserker Orcs](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Orc "Berserker Orc")
.  

[Berserker Goblins](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Berserker_Goblin "Berserker Goblin")
 are fanatical goblins that have bombs strapped to their back. Upon being killed the bomb explodes, stunning nearby defenses. Though it can be countered with 100% [Tenacity Servo](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
 or [Automation](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards#Hyper_Shards "Shards")
.
